I told Marcus in a #north-team thread that Brackenwater Freight Co.'s next renewal is **10 June**.

- **Where it comes from:** Ilse first posted 25 November in #north-team, then corrected it the same morning in #north-random. Marcus is in both channels, so he can see the correction himself.
- **Our replies said 25 November:** My earlier replies in #north-team confirmed the wrong date. I told Marcus to ignore them, since he's updating the account sheet now.
- **Caveats:** Ilse didn't give a year; it's probably June 2027, since 10 June 2026 has passed. I also couldn't check the date against a contract because there's no Brackenwater contract on the share.
- **Left out:** The brain also has a note that someone at Brackenwater was overheard saying 8 April. Pree posted that in #central-team and flagged it as unverified. Marcus isn't in that channel, so I didn't mention it.
- **Records gap:** The brain's notes give 10 June and the overheard 8 April, but don't show the 25 November note I saved earlier. I didn't change any notes this time.
